acceptanceCriteria: An over-limit plan or trace reports a fixed code that names which bound was exceeded, with the limit and the observed count.
docs/DOGFOOD.md states both limits and the supported route for a change that exceeds them.
body: Observed while binding the 2026-09-26/27 integration changes on origin/main (PR #276 and earlier). internal/dogfoodflow/change.go:719 marks the OCM link plan NOT_PRODUCED invalid-ocm-link-plan when it has more than 256 rows, and internal/trace/record.go:22 caps a trace at MaxTracePaths = 200. A change that touches more files than that cannot bind in one pass; the only workaround is splitting the change into several PRs by hand. The refusal names the plan as invalid rather than naming the bound that was exceeded, so the operator has to read the source to learn why. Proposal: report the exceeded bound by name (rows or paths, limit and actual count) and document the split route in docs/DOGFOOD.md, or admit a directory-prefix row that covers many paths as one row.

title: Dogfood bind refuses a change over 256 OCM link rows or 200 trace paths with no split route
